$comment: Route table: intent -> tier -> model -> permission. Seeded defaults; the SpacetimeDB route_rule table overrides these once connected. margin_bp is basis points over provider cost (0 = pass-through). Tier kind: chat (answers the user), decisions (Jev: typed decisions only, used for routing and checks), tagger (chips JSON). allowed_models is the per-request `model` allowlist for chat tiers.

fast.note: Fast chat tier. Set 2026-09-28 after openrouter/auto resolved to a reasoning model with ~2.5s to first token; awaiting Justin's confirmation.

careful.note: Same as fast until per-tier models are confirmed.

jev.note: TypeSafe Jev via the Decisions API. Typed decisions only (choice / noul / score), never prose. Routes intents and answers yes/no checks. $0.042 per million input tokens, output free. Override with OPENROUTER_JEV_MODEL.

tagger.note: Chips as JSON on keystroke pause when the dev toggle is on. $0.10/$0.40 per million. Not Haiku (10x the price).
